01 / About Me

Curiosity with purpose.

My journey is shaped by a desire to learn, connect people, and turn ideas into meaningful results.

01

My Approach

I believe strong leadership is not only about directing from the front. It is about helping people grow, solving problems together, and creating an environment where everyone can contribute.

I am a motivated Emirati student with a passion for discovery and a desire to lead with impact. I find fulfillment in connecting people, transforming abstract concepts into tangible results, and engineering creative solutions to genuine challenges.

My academic interests are centered on mathematics and technology. I see mathematics as a fundamental language of logic and technology as an engine for progress. Their intersection inspires me to explore innovation and contribute to a more efficient and sustainable future.

I also value excellence, community, integrity, collaboration, and purpose. Representing the UAE in academic environments is an honor, and I hope to continue reflecting the country's commitment to visionary leadership, scientific advancement, and cultural heritage.

MY GOALS

Goals & Aspirations

My goals reflect my commitment to academic achievement, personal growth, service, and building a future in technology that creates a positive impact.

Short-Term Goals

  • Achieve a 98% or higher average in my Grade 12 examinations.
  • Take an active role in community service and contribute positively to my school and wider community.
  • Earn admission to a leading university in the United States to study Computer Science.

Long-Term Goals

  • Academic Growth: Maintain excellent academic performance throughout my university studies while continuously developing my technical knowledge.
  • Professional Experience: Gain valuable industry experience through an internship at a leading technology company in the United States.
  • Leadership & Community: Participate in university and community initiatives that strengthen my leadership skills and allow me to represent the UAE positively.
  • Career Impact: Build a successful career with a leading UAE technology company and use my skills to contribute to the country's digital and technological development.

My Core Values

To achieve these goals, I will be guided by three principles: Tenacity to keep moving forward, Devotion to remain committed to my ambitions, and Innovation to continuously create better solutions and new possibilities.

15 November 2024

UAEU Critical Thinking Activity

United Arab Emirates University

Critical Thinking

UAEU critical thinking activities are structured learning exercises designed to train students in analyzing complex information, evaluating logic, and solving real-world problems rather than relying on rote memorization. Embedded within the university's General Education Program and academic workshops, these activities use frameworks like the SEE-I method (State, Explain, Exemplify, Illustrate), case study analysis, and structured debates to help students identify assumptions, spot logical fallacies, and evaluate media source credibility. By emphasizing both cognitive skills and intellectual traits like open-mindedness and intellectual humility, UAEU aims to equip students with the analytical mindset necessary for academic success, ethical decision-making, and leadership in a modern knowledge economy.
